svg.title: Compare risk in context
svg.desc: Supplement: the same permission error does not imply equal risk. Public information also needs integrity and availability. Public health articles: Intended for public reading; alteration or deletion can still harm readers or interrupt service. Private medical records: Not intended for public reading; unauthorized disclosure can harm privacy and trust. Shared assessment factors: Allowed operations, exposure, safeguards and consequences—not merely a weakness count.
